incident-bot: ALERT: automated page fired for SEV2 - rate limiter anomaly (quota-enforcement path)
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-3195551 triggered -> @maria (oncall) notified
maria: acking. seeing spikes in 502s and 429 from edge -> ratecap subsystem. pulling logs now
jon: I'm on it, grabbing limiter logs + quota-mapper traces. any customer reports?
ashley: Support: two customers reported increased request failures 10:02-10:08 UTC, some retries time out. Not many yet but trending up. ticket IDs: #2456, #2457
maria: summary from quick glance: quota mapper returned default-deny for a subset of tokens. looks like tag mismatch between token -> tenant map and quota config. could be rollout of new tag parsing? rolling back parser patch would be quick.
devon: wait, there's a control-plane deploy in progress 10:00 UTC that touched quota-mapper config parsing. @jon can you confirm commit id?
jon: yep commit d9a1f2b changed tag parsing regex in quota-mapper. Config rollout to prod started at 10:01. rolling back to previous config now.
maria: mitigation plan: 1) rollback quota-mapper config 2) flip soft-fail on enforcement so requests pass through 3) monitor 200/429 ratio
ashley: updating support channel and affected customers. setting expectation: investigating, possible transient throttles.
john? (no response) -- ignore
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook link: <https://intranet/runbooks/quota-mapper-rollback> - steps below
maria: executing rollback: kubectl -n infra patch configmap quota-mapper -p '{"data":{"tag_regex":"<previous>"}}'
jon: logs show mapper returning 403 for ~0.8% of tokens between 10:02-10:06. sample:
```
2026-03-15T10:03:12Z quota-mapper[1961]: token=tok_XXX tenant_id=unknown action=deny reason=tag_parse_mismatch
2026-03-15T10:03:13Z quota-mapper[1961]: token=tok_YYY tenant_id=unknown action=deny reason=tag_parse_mismatch
```
maria: rollback applied at 10:06:12 UTC. flipping enforcement -> soft-pass now: /control/enforcement set soft
devon: enforcement toggled. route check: edge -> limiter -> quota-mapper shows allow flows resumed.
ashley: Support: reporting back to customers that we expect recovery within minutes. will monitor.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by maria @10:06:30 UTC
maria: monitoring token-level success ratio, request rate, and 95p latency. dashboard: https://console/redwood/observability/incidents/3195551
jon: still seeing a small tail of 429s from proxy cache TTL mismatch. clearing edge cache for the affected routes.
maria: edge cache purge done at 10:08:05 UTC. 429s dropped to baseline ~10:09.
ashley: customers updated and acknowledged. no escalations from support.
devon: root cause hypothesis: config deployment changed tag parsing causing tokens to not map to tenants -> quota looked like overuse and enforcement denied requests. two parts: rollout without canary + enforcement set to block instead of soft-fail.
maria: impact assessment: customers impacted ~0.9% of requests across multi-region fleet, peak error window ~6m, major customer retries caused increased latency but no data loss.
jon: post-mortem action items:
- revert deploy gating: enforce config canaries for quota-mapper (owner: infra)
- ensure enforcement defaults to soft-pass during config rollouts (owner: product)
- add regression test for tag parsing regex (owner: eng-ml)
- alert tuning: add anomaly threshold to detect sudden spike in unknown_tenant denies (owner: obs)
ashley: I'll open customer comms template and share with SRE for review.
sre-runbook-bot: Reminder: create post-incident ticket and assign severity, link logs.
maria: creating incident ticket and adding timeline. assigning owners to the action items. thanks all for quick response. closing PD incident after monitoring window.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-3195551 marked resolved by maria @10:20:00 UTC
jon: quick note: we'll run a targeted audit of recent config changes to ensure nothing else slipped in.
ashley: verifying with customers that things look normal on their side.
maria: final status: mitigation successful, service restored to baseline by 10:09. follow-ups required as listed. will schedule a blameless postmortem tomorrow 16:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
devon: adding postmortem doc and timeline to ticket now.
ashley: closing support tickets once customers confirm stable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Automated summary posted to #incidents-log: "SEV2 3195551 - quota-mapper config parsing regression -> rollback -> recovered"
